info.title: Fluxora Ticketing API
info.description: Complete backend API deployed at https://api-eticket.fluxorastudio.id (development: https://dev-api-eticket.fluxorastudio.id). Includes customer, staff, partner integration, payment callback and operational endpoints. Staff and tenant authorization are enforced per route.

servers.description: Production API hostname in current deployment configuration

get.description: Returns process liveness.

404.description: Resource unavailable or outside caller scope

409.description: Conflict, expired quote, inventory or idempotency conflict

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes requestId

get.description: Checks database connectivity.

404.description: Resource unavailable or outside caller scope

409.description: Conflict, expired quote, inventory or idempotency conflict

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes requestId

get.description: Lists published future events and public catalogue availability hints. Availability is advisory; request a quote to validate inventory.

404.description: Resource unavailable or outside caller scope

409.description: Conflict, expired quote, inventory or idempotency conflict

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes requestId

get.description: Returns a published event by slug, including performances, ticket types and bundles.

404.description: Resource unavailable or outside caller scope

409.description: Conflict, expired quote, inventory or idempotency conflict

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes requestId

post.description: Validates selection prices and sale windows and reserves inventory. Requires email and at least one ticket or bundle selection. Quote accessToken is a bearer secret.

404.description: Resource unavailable or outside caller scope

409.description: Conflict, expired quote, inventory or idempotency conflict

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes requestId

post.description: Creates an order from a valid quote. Supply Idempotency-Key and quote ID/access token; reuse the same key for retries.

404.description: Resource unavailable or outside caller scope

409.description: Conflict, expired quote, inventory or idempotency conflict

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes requestId

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 16–128 safe characters. Reuse the same value for retries of this attempt.

get.description: Returns order, payment and ticket delivery state. Requires quote access token as Bearer credential. Treat response as sensitive.

404.description: Resource unavailable or outside caller scope

409.description: Conflict, expired quote, inventory or idempotency conflict

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes requestId

post.summary: Create or replay QRIS payment session
post.description: Creates or replays provider payment instructions. Requires quote access token. Provider status verification is authoritative.

404.description: Resource unavailable or outside caller scope

409.description: Conflict, expired quote, inventory or idempotency conflict

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes requestId

post.description: Provider callback prompts server-side payment status reconciliation. Callback fields alone never settle an order.

404.description: Resource unavailable or outside caller scope

409.description: Conflict, expired quote, inventory or idempotency conflict

500.description: Unexpected server error; response includes requestId
